title: Rejection of Invalid Trailing Payloads
statement: Let $m\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and let $z$ and $t$ be bit strings. If $t$ either is empty or does not end in $1$, or if $|t|$ exceeds the length of the binary representation of the length of $\langle z,t\rangle$, then the indicator of the mode-$m$ drop language is false on $\langle z,t\rangle$.
